policy: Proposed work queue only. Tasks are not assigned, started, completed, or externally authorised by appearing here. Dependencies are explicit; status and execution state change only when evidence is recorded and reviewed.
approval_policy: No spending or paid subscriptions without explicit owner approval.
No external applications, client contact, submissions or commitments without explicit owner approval.
No publishing, production deployment, repository merge or permission change without explicit owner approval.
No live trading, wallet connection, signing, deposits or withdrawals without separate explicit approval and readiness review.
Risk division may independently challenge and recommend stop; it cannot authorise execution.

tasks.title: Establish weekly executive review pack
tasks.objective: Consolidate division scorecard, dependency blockers, risks, decisions and owner approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard output is generated from current source records
Every unverified item is labelled and no division is promoted to ready
tasks.approval_gate: No external action; owner confirmation required for reserved decisions

tasks.title: Create owner decision and approval queue
tasks.objective: Turn outstanding owner decisions into scoped requests with evidence and explicit outcomes.
required_evidence: Decision register with scope, impact and requested approval
acceptance_criteria: Each request states exact action, cost/risk and reversibility
No silent approval; unresolved requests remain pending
tasks.approval_gate: Owner approval required before any reserved action

tasks.title: Refresh zero-cost opportunity shortlist
tasks.objective: Identify legitimate Canada-eligible opportunities and record official terms, payout rules, fees and evidence dates.
required_evidence: Official source links and eligibility notes
acceptance_criteria: Every shortlisted opportunity has official URL, eligibility state, costs and payment terms or explicit unknowns
No upfront spend is assumed
tasks.approval_gate: Applications, client contact, submissions and paid commitments require owner approval

tasks.title: Prepare one evidence-backed AI service offer
tasks.objective: Draft a narrowly scoped service offer and sample deliverable using capabilities already available without paid tools.
acceptance_criteria: Claims are truthful and evidence-backed
Scope, delivery time, exclusions and zero-upfront-cost assumptions are explicit
tasks.approval_gate: Publishing, outreach, applications and client commitments require owner approval

tasks.title: Create reproducible engineering quality baseline
tasks.objective: Document repo structure, local checks, CI checks, branch policy and rollback expectations for the organisation control centre.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewer can reproduce all checks
No secrets, production changes or permissions are introduced
tasks.approval_gate: Merge, deployment and permission changes require owner approval

tasks.title: Build task-queue and dashboard integration
tasks.objective: Implement schema validation and read-only queue reporting with regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: All queue records validate and dependency cycles are rejected
Dashboard shows proposed, blocked and completed states without changing them
tasks.approval_gate: Feature-branch engineering only; merge requires owner approval

tasks.title: Verify current AI revenue opportunity channels
tasks.objective: Research official platform terms, Canada access, eligibility, payment methods, fees, minimum payout and identity requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Primary sources and checked dates are recorded
Unknowns and jurisdiction limits are visible
tasks.approval_gate: Research only; account creation, applications and attestations require owner action

tasks.title: Maintain technical and crypto intelligence brief
tasks.objective: Track material technical, market-data and simulation risks relevant to paper-only PolyBot work.
required_evidence: Research brief with sources, confidence and refresh triggers
acceptance_criteria: Facts, assumptions and opinions are separated
No live trading recommendation is treated as authorisation
tasks.approval_gate: No wallet access, deposits, withdrawals or live execution

tasks.title: Establish zero-budget financial baseline
tasks.objective: Define available evidence, cash classifications, approved budget default, fee tracking and CAD conversion rules.
acceptance_criteria: Estimates, accepted earnings and cash received remain separate
Unverified balances are clearly marked; no bank access is presumed
tasks.approval_gate: No account access, transfers, borrowing, investments or paid commitments

tasks.title: Create portfolio unit-economics review
tasks.objective: Model net cash, fees, direct costs, hours and downside for proposed revenue channels using verified inputs only.
acceptance_criteria: Every figure has source, currency and date
Potential riba/yield concerns are flagged, not assumed compliant
tasks.approval_gate: Analysis only; financial transactions require explicit approval

tasks.title: Establish independent cross-division risk register
tasks.objective: Define risk severity, impact, controls, owner, evidence, escalation and stop recommendation fields.
acceptance_criteria: Critical risks have containment and escalation guidance
Risk authority remains advisory/stop-only
tasks.approval_gate: Cannot authorise execution or override deterministic controls

tasks.title: Review paper-trading safety boundary
tasks.objective: Independently challenge paper/live separation, order-path absence, key handling, stale-data controls and recovery assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: No live order, signing or wallet capability is present in the reviewed paper scope
Findings include evidence and unresolved gaps
tasks.approval_gate: No live trading, wallet connection, signing, deposits or withdrawals

tasks.title: Complete deterministic position and exit-engine specification
tasks.objective: Specify paper-only position states, sizing, stop/exit rules, fees, slippage, partial fills and restart behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Every state transition has deterministic rules and auditable reasons
No live execution interface is specified
tasks.approval_gate: Paper simulation only; live scope requires separate approval

tasks.title: Implement and test paper-only position lifecycle
tasks.objective: Build isolated simulation logic and tests for entry, add/reduce, stop, exit, duplicate signals, stale data and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Normal, edge, outage and restart scenarios are tested
Paper mode cannot sign or send real orders
tasks.approval_gate: No wallet, keys, signing, deposits, withdrawals or live orders

tasks.title: Preserve current store baseline
tasks.objective: Prepare a read-only inventory of existing eBay/Printify assets, listing status, shipping, variants and known issues from available records.
acceptance_criteria: No account changes or assumptions about live listing state
Deferred status is retained
tasks.approval_gate: No listing, purchase, publishing or account changes

tasks.title: Prepare future listing preflight checklist
tasks.objective: Define product cost, shipping, variant, price, fee, margin and scam checks for future owner-approved listings.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist catches missing cost, shipping, size and margin inputs
No listing is published

tasks.title: Preserve Animora brand and IP inventory
tasks.objective: Record the existing brand direction, site references and original characters Lyra, Kaito, Miko and Solen without consuming paid credits.
acceptance_criteria: Existing creative identity and character names are preserved accurately
No Lovable credits or paid services are consumed
tasks.approval_gate: Preservation only; no paid tool use or public changes

tasks.title: Outline future studio production roadmap
tasks.objective: Prepare a future-funded roadmap for original short anime production, including a five-minute short-film production pipeline and cost categories.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap is explicitly deferred until sustainable funding
No production spend or new launch is initiated
tasks.approval_gate: No spending, subscriptions, production or launch without approval
